mcp.add.busy.description: The Add server picker’s Add button while it works.

mcp.add.button.description: The Add server picker (HI-2059): the button that adds the chosen server.

mcp.add.message.defaultMessage: The workspace’s servers not added here yet. Sessions started from now on get the one you add.
mcp.add.message.description: The Add server picker (HI-2059), above its search and list: the workspace servers not added to this project (or the Hive Assistant); new sessions start the one added.

mcp.add.title.description: Title of the Add server picker (HI-2059) in a project's MCP tab. {project} is the project.

mcp.add.titleAssistant.defaultMessage: Add a server for the Hive Assistant
mcp.add.titleAssistant.description: Title of the Add server picker (HI-2059) in the Hive Assistant's view.

mcp.addFile.messageAdded.defaultMessage: Adds {file} to the workspace (.hive/mcp){files, plural, =0 {} one {, with its file in a folder of its own} other {, with its # files in a folder of its own}}, added to no project yet. Add it where it should run: a project’s MCP tab, the Hive Assistant’s view, or Add to… here. It runs:
mcp.addFile.messageAdded.description: Add MCP Server from File (HI-2059), above the command the server runs. {file} is the file added; {files} how many files a .zip brings. Keep .hive/mcp as it is; "MCP tab" and "Add to…" as Hive shows them.

mcp.addFile.replaceDetailAdded.defaultMessage: Replace moves it (and the folder of one added from a .zip) to the Recycle Bin and adds this one to no project yet: projects and the Hive Assistant that had the old one lose it. Or choose another name.
mcp.addFile.replaceDetailAdded.description: When a server of that name exists, under Replace or Choose Another Name (HI-2059).

mcp.enable.all.description: The MCP view’s Add to… dialog: a button that ticks every project (not the Hive Assistant, which has its own box).

mcp.enable.assistant.description: The MCP view’s Add to… dialog: the box that adds the server for the Hive Assistant, after the projects.

mcp.enable.none.description: The MCP view’s Add to… dialog: a button that unticks every project (not the Hive Assistant, which has its own box).

mcp.error.cannotClear.defaultMessage: Couldn't read the settings of {project}, so {name} wasn't changed: it may still be added there. Try again once the project can be read.
mcp.error.cannotClear.description: An error replacing, creating or deleting an MCP server (HI-2059): a project's settings file could not be read, so Hive could not make sure the server is removed there, and changed nothing. {project} is the project's folder name, {name} the server.

mcp.error.invalidName.description: An error: an MCP server name Hive refuses.

mcp.error.noProject.defaultMessage: {project} is no longer a project in this workspace.
mcp.error.noProject.description: An error adding an MCP server to a project, or removing it (HI-2059): the project was removed or moved meanwhile. {project} is its folder name.

mcp.error.noServerAdd.defaultMessage: The workspace has no MCP server named {name}.
mcp.error.noServerAdd.description: An error adding a server to a project or the Hive Assistant. {name} is its name.

mcp.import.added.description: After Copy to workspace (HI-2059): where the copied servers are added.

mcp.import.changedAdded.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {{names} changed in the project's config after you saw it, so it was copied but not added: check what it runs and add it in the project's MCP tab.} other {{names} changed in the project's config after you saw them, so they were copied but not added: check what they run and add them in the project's MCP tab.}}
mcp.import.changedAdded.description: After Copy to workspace, when servers changed between the confirmation and the copy. {names} lists them, {count} how many.

mcp.import.confirmButtonAdded.description: Button (HI-2059): copies the project's MCP servers to the workspace and adds them to the project.

mcp.import.confirmMessageAdded.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {It is added to {project} straight away; other projects can add it in their MCP tab. It runs:} other {They are added to {project} straight away; other projects can add them in their MCP tab. They run:}}
mcp.import.confirmMessageAdded.description: Copy to workspace's confirmation, above what the servers run. {count} is how many; {project} the project they come from.

mcp.import.confirmTitle.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Copy {name} to the workspace?} other {Copy # MCP servers to the workspace?}}
mcp.import.confirmTitle.description: Title of Copy to workspace's confirmation. {count} servers a project defines in its own config; {name} the one when there is one.

mcp.import.readFailed.description: An error's title: reading the MCP servers a project defines in its own config failed.

mcp.picker.added.description: The MCP servers' filter: servers added to a project or the Hive Assistant.

mcp.picker.all.description: The MCP servers' filter: every server.

mcp.picker.allAdded.defaultMessage: Every server in the workspace is added here already.
mcp.picker.allAdded.description: The Add server picker (HI-2059) when every workspace server is added to this project or the Hive Assistant.

mcp.picker.choose.defaultMessage: Choose a server to see what it runs.
mcp.picker.choose.description: The Add server picker (HI-2059) before a server is chosen; Add stays greyed out until one is.

mcp.picker.errors.description: The MCP view's filter: servers whose definition Hive can't use.

mcp.picker.filter.description: Accessible name of the filter beside the MCP servers' search box (All, Added somewhere, Added nowhere).

mcp.picker.noMatch.description: The MCP servers' list when nothing matches the search and filter.

mcp.picker.nowhere.description: The MCP servers' filter: servers added to no project and not to the Hive Assistant.

mcp.picker.runs.description: The Add server picker (HI-2059): above what the chosen server runs (its command, address, folder, environment).

mcp.picker.search.defaultMessage: Search by name, description or tag
mcp.picker.search.description: The search box of the MCP view and of the Add server picker (HI-2059): finds servers by their name, description or tags.

mcp.places.addedIn.description: After Add to… (HI-2059) failed in part: the places the server was added to. {places} lists projects (and the Hive Assistant).

mcp.places.button.description: The MCP view’s Add to… dialog (HI-2059): the button that adds the server where ticked and removes it where unticked.

mcp.places.failedIn.description: After Add to… (HI-2059) failed in part: a place where the change could not be written, and why ({error}, as Hive or Windows said it).

mcp.places.message.defaultMessage: Sessions started from now on get it wherever it is ticked; unticking removes it there. It runs:
mcp.places.message.description: The MCP view’s Add to… dialog (HI-2059), above the command the server runs and the projects (and the Hive Assistant) to tick.

mcp.places.noProjects.defaultMessage: The workspace has no projects yet: add it in a project's MCP tab once there is one.
mcp.places.noProjects.description: The MCP view’s Add to… dialog (HI-2059) when the workspace has no projects to choose.

mcp.places.partial.defaultMessage: {name} was changed in only some places
mcp.places.partial.description: A warning's title after the MCP view's Add to… (HI-2059): some of the places could not be written; the message says which changed and which didn't. {name} is the server.

mcp.places.projects.description: The MCP view’s Add to… dialog (HI-2059): the label above the projects to tick.

mcp.places.projectsLabel.description: Accessible name of the list of projects to tick in the MCP view’s Add to… dialog (HI-2059).

mcp.places.removedFrom.description: After Add to… (HI-2059) failed in part: the places the server was removed from. {places} lists projects (and the Hive Assistant).

mcp.places.title.description: Title of the dialog in the MCP view (HI-2059) that chooses the projects, and the Hive Assistant, an MCP server is added to. {name} is the server.

mcp.tab.hintAdded.defaultMessage: The workspace's MCP servers this project's agents get. Add one from the workspace's servers; Remove takes it off this project only.
mcp.tab.hintAdded.description: Under Added servers in a project's MCP tab (HI-2059).

mcp.tab.projectDefinedAdded.defaultMessage: These servers are in the project's own agent config (such as .mcp.json). Hive starts sessions with only workspace servers, so they stay disabled until copied to the workspace, which adds them here.
mcp.tab.projectDefinedAdded.description: Under Defined by the project in a project's MCP tab (HI-2059: copying one to the workspace adds it to this project). Keep .mcp.json as it is.

mcp.view.addTo.description: A button in an MCP server's view (HI-2059): chooses the projects, and the Hive Assistant, it is added to.

mcp.where.addedAssistantOnly.defaultMessage: Added for the Hive Assistant only
mcp.where.addedAssistantOnly.description: Where an MCP server is added (HI-2059), under it in the MCP view: for the Hive Assistant, in no project.

mcp.where.addedNone.description: Where an MCP server is added (HI-2059), under it in the MCP view: no project and not the Hive Assistant, so it runs nowhere.

mcp.where.addedSome.description: Where an MCP server is added (HI-2059), under it in the MCP view. {projects} lists the projects.

mcp.where.addedSomeAndAssistant.defaultMessage: Added in {projects} and for the Hive Assistant
mcp.where.addedSomeAndAssistant.description: Where an MCP server is added (HI-2059), under it in the MCP view: in some projects and for the Hive Assistant. {projects} lists the projects.

mcp.where.assistantName.description: Where an MCP server is added (HI-2059), in a list of places beside project names.

mcp.where.hidden.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# hidden project} other {# hidden projects}}
mcp.where.hidden.description: Where an MCP server is added (HI-2059), after the projects named: the hidden projects it is added to.
